crafts.name: Wall decor sign
instructions: Hot glue the long sides of the popsicle sticks together, to get a sheet that looks like a sign
Use double sided tape to stick the sheet to the wall
You now have a pretty poster in your room!
crafts.sustainability_note: Reuses a lot of popsicle sticks to create a unique poster

crafts.name: DIY wall design
instructions: Place your outline of the design down
Place popsicle sticks according to the design and hot glue in place
Use double sided tape to stick to the wall and done!
crafts.sustainability_note: The popsicle sticks are recyled into a lightweight and portable wall decor.
